result.summary: Cedar Homes reported on 11 Feb (event 019) that the window handle job was complete. The system flag about "3+ reminders" (event 020) is out of date, because it came after that completion email. Following lesson #4, I moved the ticket to close-out. The invoice they mentioned isn't visible in the CRM, so it can't be checked or forwarded yet. I asked Cedar Homes to resend it, asked the tenant to confirm the window now works, told the landlord where things stand, and set a 3-day hold.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord approved the job ('Please go ahead', event 012) and Cedar Homes reported it complete (event 019), so the job belongs in close-out, not scheduling. The reminders in events 017, 018 and 020 were automated and are stale. The invoice isn't visible and no amount was ever approved, so nothing can be forwarded for payment until it has been checked.

alternatives_considered.why_not: The contractor had already replied with completion, so there is nothing for a person to chase.

alternatives_considered.option: Close straight away as lesson #4 suggests (no chasing the contractor)
alternatives_considered.why_not: I departed from the lesson on one point. The invoice must be checked before payment and we can't see it, so one request to resend it is needed. We also still need the landlord to sign off.

alternatives_considered.option: Forward the invoice to the landlord
alternatives_considered.why_not: The invoice isn't visible and no amount is on record.

checks_performed: Landlord approval in event 012 (no amount stated)
Contractor on the ticket (Cedar Homes) matches the sender of the completion email (Noah Ellis, Cedar Homes)

No open holds or approvals before this action
Property history: there is another ticket for the same issue (R/PM044-1), which may be a duplicate

result.situation: Window handle at the top of the stairs fell off. The landlord approved and Cedar Homes was assigned. The contractor reported the job complete and said an invoice was attached, but it isn't visible. The system then flagged that reminders had been sent.

actions_taken.result: Invoice or completion report; 'review'; no amount mentioned

actions_taken.description: Looked up how similar contractor completion reports were handled
Asked the tenant to confirm the window handle works
Asked Cedar Homes to resend the invoice
Told the landlord where things stand and that the invoice will come to them once checked
Hold while waiting for the invoice and the tenant's confirmation

escalation.reason: A normal close-out step; the reminder flag is out of date

unverified: Completion is reported by the contractor only; the tenant hasn't confirmed it yet
Invoice amount and payee (we can't see the invoice)
Tenant phone number: 07700 900307 was given in events 015/017, but 07700 900251 in event 016
Tenant name: Harriet (events 005/007) vs Nora Quinn on the record
risks_or_red_flags: No cost was ever agreed. If the invoice amount is high, the landlord needs to confirm it before payment
Ticket R/PM044-1 on the same property is still open for the same issue (possible duplicate)
result.final_status: Close-out, on hold (hold 266) waiting for the contractor's invoice and the tenant's confirmation

next_follow_up.what: Check the invoice against the approved job, contractor and property, then send it to the landlord for confirmation. If the tenant has confirmed the fix, close the ticket. If not, chase both.
